desc: Build a trie with pass-through counts and record the trie-node path for every word.
Compute, for each prefix depth, how many trie nodes have count at least k.
Identify critical trie nodes whose count equals exactly k, since removing a word only invalidates these nodes on its path.
For each word, find the greatest depth that remains valid using per-depth qualifying counts and a segment tree.
Verify provided samples and edge cases, including k = 1, duplicates, no valid prefixes, and insufficient remaining strings.
